description: Unit tests for proxy string utility functions in the net namespace, testing parsing and conversion of proxy server URIs, including special cases and invalid inputs.

methods.name: ProxyUriToProxyServer
methods.description: Converts a proxy URI string to a ProxyServer object, parsing scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: ProxyServerToProxyUri
methods.description: Converts a ProxyServer object back to its URI string representation.

methods.name: ProxyServerToPacResultElement
methods.description: Generates PAC result string element from a ProxyServer.

methods.name: PacResultElementToProxyServer
methods.description: Parses a PAC result string element into a ProxyServer object.
